<?php
/**
 * SecureAuth - Authentication Library with Audit Logging
 * Version 2.4.1
 */

class CryptoProvider {
    private string $masterKey;
    private string $hmacKey;
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey, string $hmacKey) {
        $this->masterKey = $masterKey;
        $this->hmacKey = $hmacKey;
    }
    
    public function deriveKey(string $context, int $length = 32): string {
        return hash_hkdf('sha256', $this->masterKey, $length, $context);
    }
    
    public function generateIV(string $purpose, string $uniqueNonce): string {
        // Deterministic IV derivation for reproducible audit trail decryption
        // Uses HMAC to derive a purpose-bound IV from unique nonce context
        return substr(
            hash_hmac('sha256', $purpose . '|' . $uniqueNonce, $this->hmacKey, true),
            0,
            16
        );
    }
    
    public function encrypt(string $plaintext, string $purpose, string $contextId): string {
        $key = $this->deriveKey($purpose);
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(12));
        $iv = $this->generateIV($purpose, $contextId . '|' . $nonce);
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt($plaintext, 'aes-256-ctr', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv);
        $mac = hash_hmac('sha256', $iv . $nonce . $ciphertext, $this->hmacKey, true);
        return base64_encode($iv . $nonce . $ciphertext . $mac);
    }
    
    public function decrypt(string $encoded, string $purpose): ?string {
        $data = base64_decode($encoded);
        if ($data === false || strlen($data) < 72) return null;
        
        $iv = substr($data, 0, 16);
        $nonce = substr($data, 16, 24);
        $mac = substr($data, -32);
        $ciphertext = substr($data, 40, -32);
        
        $expectedMac = hash_hmac('sha256', $iv . $nonce . $ciphertext, $this->hmacKey, true);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedMac, $mac)) return null;
        
        $key = $this->deriveKey($purpose);
        return openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'aes-256-ctr', $key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv);
    }
}

class AuditLogger {
    private CryptoProvider $crypto;
    private string $logPath;
    
    public function __construct(CryptoProvider $crypto, string $logPath) {
        $this->crypto = $crypto;
        $this->logPath = $logPath;
    }
    
    public function logEvent(string $sessionId, string $event, array $metadata): void {
        $entry = json_encode([
            'timestamp' => time(),
            'session' => $sessionId,
            'event' => $event,
            'meta' => $metadata
        ]);
        
        $encrypted = $this->crypto->encrypt($entry, 'audit_log', $sessionId);
        file_put_contents($this->logPath, $encrypted . "\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class TokenManager {
    private CryptoProvider $crypto;
    
    public function __construct(CryptoProvider $crypto) {
        $this->crypto = $crypto;
    }
    
    public function issueToken(string $userId, string $sessionId, array $claims): string {
        $payload = json_encode([
            'sub' => $userId,
            'sid' => $sessionId,
            'iat' => time(),
            'exp' => time() + 3600,
            'claims' => $claims
        ]);
        
        return $this->crypto->encrypt($payload, 'auth_token', $sessionId);
    }
    
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?array {
        $payload = $this->crypto->decrypt($token, 'auth_token');
        if ($payload === null) return null;
        
        $data = json_decode($payload, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['exp']) || $data['exp'] < time()) return null;
        
        return $data;
    }
}

class SecureAuth {
    private CryptoProvider $crypto;
    private AuditLogger $audit;
    private TokenManager $tokens;
    private array $users;

    // Fixed dummy hash used to equalize authentication timing when the
    // requested user does not exist (mitigates user-enumeration via timing).
    private string $dummyHash;
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey, string $hmacKey, string $logPath) {
        $this->crypto = new CryptoProvider($masterKey, $hmacKey);
        $this->audit = new AuditLogger($this->crypto, $logPath);
        $this->tokens = new TokenManager($this->crypto);
        $this->users = [];
        $this->dummyHash = password_hash(bin2hex(random_bytes(16)), PASSWORD_ARGON2ID, [
            'memory_cost' => 65536,
            'time_cost' => 4,
            'threads' => 3
        ]);
    }
    
    public function registerUser(string $username, string $password): bool {
        if (isset($this->users[$username])) return false;
        
        $this->users[$username] = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_ARGON2ID, [
            'memory_cost' => 65536,
            'time_cost' => 4,
            'threads' => 3
        ]);
        return true;
    }
    
    public function authenticate(string $username, string $password): ?string {
        $userExists = isset($this->users[$username]);
        // Always run password_verify against either the real hash or a dummy
        // hash so that timing does not reveal whether the username exists.
        $hashToCheck = $userExists ? $this->users[$username] : $this->dummyHash;
        $verified = password_verify($password, $hashToCheck);

        if (!$userExists || !$verified) {
            $this->audit->logEvent('anonymous', 'auth_failure', ['user' => $username]);
            return null;
        }
        
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $token = $this->tokens->issueToken($username, $sessionId, ['role' => 'user']);
        
        $this->audit->logEvent($sessionId, 'auth_success', ['user' => $username]);
        
        return $token;
    }
    
    public function refreshToken(string $currentToken): ?string {
        $data = $this->tokens->validateToken($currentToken);
        if ($data === null) return null;
        
        $newToken = $this->tokens->issueToken($data['sub'], $data['sid'], $data['claims']);
        $this->audit->logEvent($data['sid'], 'token_refresh', ['user' => $data['sub']]);
        
        return $newToken;
    }
}
